reviews.title: Impressive and effortless, cross platform and independent - 100/10
reviews.comment:
Nothing to say that hasn't already been said - it's a high quality product at a fair price. Camera and Mic quality are outstanding; the latter also seems to have some noise isolating properties which are pretty impressive. Mounting is super easy as well. I've never had a webcam that wasn't integrated into a laptop before, so it seemed a little "weird" to physically set up and balance the camera on the monitor, but that's really nothing attributable to the camera itself.
In the scope of compatibility, I will add that this also works seamlessly, and the quality/fidelity of both the camera and the integrated mic are excellent. Out of the box, even a fairly obscure and sparsely "packaged" and systemd-less Linux system picked this up and ran with it, requiring no configuration or troubleshooting. Also tested on Mac and Windows - they also have some additional features via a desktop configuration utility for those platforms.
reviews.author: Patrick

reviews.title: Good quality and affordable
reviews.comment: Works great - easy to run and Logitech has software on their website to help you optimise your camera. I don't personally use the microphone on the camera as I have a separate one, so I can't comment on that, but I haven't had any issues with it. Good quality images.
reviews.author: Briony

reviews.title: A Solid Webcam with a Simple, Effective Privacy Shutter
reviews.comment:
I bought the Logitech C920S HD Pro Webcam and have been very pleased with it. The video quality is excellent, with a clear and crisp 1080p resolution that works great for video calls on platforms like Zoom and Skype.
The included privacy shutter is a simple but effective feature. It's a small plastic attachment that you can easily flip up and down, providing peace of mind and an extra layer of security when the camera is not in use. It's a no-fuss solution that gets the job done.
Overall, this is a great webcam for anyone who needs reliable, high-quality video for their computer.
reviews.author: Steph D.

reviews.title: You are on your own to get it to work.  Software not included
reviews.comment:
Nice little camera, well packaged, nice clear image, pretty good audio.
That's the good news.
The bad news they don't tell you ....
You have to have other programs to even turn it on.  It does NOT come with its own software.  Both the online downloadable ? software AND the "customer support" both suffer from the same malady ...  "Chinglish".  Written and verbal support appear to have been written in Chinese and (poorly) translated into English of a sort.
reviews.author: JimW
